query:
UPDATE integrations SET last_seen_at = $2, last_error = $3, last_status = $4,
                    last_error_field = $5, last_payload = $6,
                    last_item_id = COALESCE($7, last_item_id),
                    last_item_title = COALESCE($8, last_item_title)
             WHERE id = $1
